title: Responsive WebGL canvas shell
summary: Create a full-viewport renderer with a perspective camera, pixel-ratio cap, and a resize handler that updates aspect and drawing buffer together.

title: Globe from sphere geometry
summary: Build a simple planet as a UV sphere with enough segments for a smooth silhouette, then parent it so orbit and spin can be animated independently.

title: Scene, camera, light starter
summary: A minimal look setup: hemisphere fill, a keyed directional light, and a camera pulled back on z so a unit-scale subject reads clearly.

title: GSAP-owned render loop
summary: Drive rendering from gsap.ticker so speed controls can scale the global timeline without a second clock.

title: Slow globe spin
summary: Spin a planet on Y with a long linear tween so the motion reads as axial rotation rather than a whip.
codeSnippet: gsap.to(globe.rotation, { y: Math.PI * 2, duration: 18, ease: 'none', repeat: -1 });

title: Orbital pivot around a sun
summary: Orbit a child globe around a world-origin sun by rotating a parent group, keeping local spin independent.

title: Slow camera drift
summary: Ease the camera along a short arc over three seconds with power2.inOut so the move decelerates instead of popping.

title: Three-second intro timeline
summary: Stage a critic-length beat: fade in, ease the camera, then settle rotation with power2.out.

title: Power2 deceleration
summary: Prefer power2.out or power3.out at the end of a move so transforms do not stop linearly.
codeSnippet:
gsap.to(subject.position, { y: 0.25, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power2.out' });
gsap.to(subject.rotation, { x: 0.15, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power3.out' });

title: Staggered mesh reveals
summary: Reveal a small set of objects with a bounded stagger so the beat stays inside a few seconds.

title: Fresnel rim on a globe
summary: A small original fresnel term brightens grazing angles so a sphere reads as a volume instead of a flat disc.

title: Iridescent view-dependent tint
summary: Mix two hues with a view angle so a globe or shell shifts color without copying a third-party iridescence shader.

title: Soft vertex displacement
summary: Offset sphere vertices along normals with a small sine field so the silhouette stays smooth.

title: Animated shader uniform
summary: Drive a material uniform with GSAP instead of mutating geometry every frame.
codeSnippet:
material.uniforms.pulse = { value: 0 };
gsap.to(material.uniforms.pulse, { value: 1, duration: 2.4, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, ease: 'sine.inOut' });

title: Matcap-free glossy plastic
summary: A MeshPhysicalMaterial with modest clearcoat and low roughness for a glass-adjacent planet without transmission cost.

title: Thin glass globe
summary: Transmission on a sphere for a glass planet; keep thickness low and env intensity modest so lighting stays stable in motion.

title: Warm emissive sun core
summary: Use emissive color instead of a point light for the sun disc so the core stays bright while orbiting lights remain separate.

title: Layered atmosphere shell
summary: A slightly larger transparent sphere with additive blending suggests haze around a globe.

title: Warm key, cool fill
summary: Oppose a warm directional key with a cool hemisphere fill so materials read during camera motion.

title: Stable orbit lighting
summary: Keep lights in world space, not parented to the orbiting globe, so exposure does not strobe during revolution.

title: Soft rim light
summary: A dim backlight opposite the key separates a dark globe from the background.

title: Avoid light intensity pops
summary: If intensity must change, tween it with sine.inOut; never snap intensity in the critic clip.
codeSnippet: gsap.to(key, { intensity: 1.8, duration: 2, ease: 'sine.inOut', yoyo: true, repeat: -1 });

title: Pointer raycast hover
summary: Raycast from normalized pointer coords and ease a hover scale; ignore events after destroy.

title: Reduced-motion camera lock
summary: Skip looping camera tweens when the user prefers reduced motion.

title: Foundry preview control listener
summary: Honor host studio messages for speed, hue, and wireframe without extra routers.

title: Cap pixel ratio
summary: Clamp devicePixelRatio so retina screens do not double fragment cost on a simple globe.
codeSnippet: renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));

title: Bounded geometry density
summary: Use 48–64 sphere segments for a hero globe; denser meshes rarely read at this scale.
codeSnippet:
const globeGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 64, 48);
const hazeGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.05, 32, 24);

title: Dispose unused GPU resources
summary: If a generated scene replaces meshes, dispose geometry and materials to avoid leaking across reloads.

title: Tone mapping for mixed lights
summary: ACES tone mapping plus a modest exposure keeps a warm sun and cool globe from clipping during motion.

title: Alpha background for studio iframe
summary: Enable renderer alpha and a transparent scene background so the host preview paper shows around the globe.
codeSnippet:
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
scene.background = null;

title: Camera near far for a unit globe
summary: Keep near around 0.1 and far under 100 so a close drift does not clip the sphere.
codeSnippet:
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, innerWidth / innerHeight, 0.1, 80);
camera.position.set(0, 0.2, 4);

title: Semantic DOM mirrored into WebGL text
summary: Keep readable HTML as the source of truth, then mirror its text and measured layout into a WebGL layer after fonts load. This preserves responsive semantics while enabling custom visual treatments.

title: Single-progress WebGL hover mask
summary: Drive a WebGL card takeover from a single normalized progress value, letting an original shader mask shape the edge while DOM input handlers control the transition.

title: Scroll progress drives a section seam
summary: Bind a bounded shader mask or texture blend to scroll progress so the edge between adjacent sections responds directly to scrolling rather than running on an unrelated timer.

title: Motion personality with accessible states
summary: Define a motion brief once and give each animated element an intro, settled state, and optional outro. Ongoing motion needs pause/replay controls, stable layout, and a complete reduced-motion alternative.

title: Typed event subscriptions with teardown
summary: Keep input, audio, and scene responses loosely coupled with typed domain events, and retain an unsubscribe function so listeners cannot outlive their owning feature.
